guard: every connection-scoped KV handle, including the derived membership feed, is reopened after endpoint reconnect
why: The mutation deletes the membership-feed cache clear from the rebuild. The suite opens that cache
on the old connection before reconnect, then watches it afterward. Without the clear, the watch
reuses an object bound to the drained connection and fails on the named post-reconnect assertion.

mutations.name: the reconnect keeps the membership-feed KV bound to the closed connection epoch
mutations.expectRed: the membership feed watch re-opens on the fresh connection
mutations.cell: the membership feed watch re-opens on the fresh connection
mutations.note: The pre-reconnect read populated the cache. Deleting this one clear makes the post-reconnect watch reuse the stale KV and throw closed connection.
